connector.name: Vaquill
connector.registryDescription: Legal research: US primary law, Indian case law (31M+ judgments), and citation graph traversal.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.vaquill.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vaquill-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using a Vaquill API key. Format: 'Bearer vq_key_...'. Get a key at https://www.vaquill.ai/legal-api.
